opening.argument: Look at what the presentation actually shows: analyst teams compete in the 2017 Analyst Impact Fund finals to win grants supporting nonprofit organizations. The funding is directed to identified projects, including a $150,000 grant for Kiran Open Higher Education and a mobile application using satellite-generated maps to help pastoralists. The panels identify nonprofit efforts such as APOPO and the Bronx Freedom Fund, followed by an award presentation. Across the conference panels, project slides, and award moment, viewers are not asked to send money or participate financially; the material presents nonprofit grantmaking and operational projects instead.

citations.quote: Let me welcome everybody to the 2017 Analyst Impact Fund finals presentation.
Teams made up of nearly 300 analysts from Goldman Sachs offices around the world competed to win grants from Goldman Sachs Gives to support innovative non-profit organizations of their choice.
receiving a $150,000 grant for the organization is Kiran open higher education.
